desc:
YOUR BLUE LOCK STORY

Use Code "YourStory" For Free Rolls and State Points!🏆

Released For Mobile, Pc And Console!

Create your own character in a fan-made football (soccer) story inspired by Blue Lock. Build your career, challenge powerful rivals, and develop a playstyle that belongs to you.

 Unlock Element abilities and awaken your Ego State.
 Play matches in 3D or follow the 2D simulation and react during decisive  moments.
 Make story choices that shape your ego identity and relationships.
 Train your stats and develop your signature weapon.
 Progress through selections and international tournaments. 
 Customise your striker and display earned kits and trophies in your locker.

Play Now and Become a Egoist
